{{Noncanon}} {{Infobox Item |image= File:Recipe.png |caption= |pronunciation= |plural= |game= FPTRR |other= |cost= Varies |value= |location= |uses= Creating [[Item]]s |strength= |durability= |comp= |sample= |theme= }} {{Name|British|{{Term/Store|Recipe|Recipes|Series, FPTRR|plural}}}} are [[Item]]s in {{FPTRR}}.{{Cite|Recipes|Game Screen|FPTRR}} ==Location and Uses== Recipes allow Tingle to create certain [[Item]]s, such as [[Bomb]]s, soups, and healing potions from specific ingredients. [[Tingle]] can cook the same items free-hand and without the recipes, but cannot produce more than one batch at a time and must select each ingredient individually. There are a total of 31 recipes in all, with requirements ranging from three to fifteen ingredients. Recipes can be found in many different places; some are located in [[Treasure Chest]]s, while others can be found in [[Dungeon]]s, or generally exploring the map. Most, however, must be purchased or received - often in exchange for aid or assistance - from people in [[Port Town]] or elsewhere. All potions can be sold somewhere, and a few have no further purpose than raising [[Rupee]]s in this way.
